units.source_text: 惟光拦阻道：“里面满地荒草，草上露水极多，插不进足。

en.t: Koremitsu stopped him and said, "Inside, wild grass covers the ground, and there is so much dew on it that there is nowhere to set one's foot.

units.source_text: 必须把露水扫除一下，才好进去。”

en.t: We must sweep away the dew first; only then will it be possible to go in."
The young lord murmured a poem to himself:
